$schema_doc: Built-in mental model seeds. Each entry is created once per bank if absent. Existing models are NEVER modified by the bootstrap path — operators who want to change a curated model must delete and re-seed (or call refreshMentalModel for a content-only refresh). Tags must intersect the tags actually attached to retains, otherwise refresh returns empty (Hindsight all_strict matching). Source queries live here and not in TS so changes are reviewable as data, not code. `max_tokens` bounds server-side reflect generation per model; a separate client-side render budget bounds the total injected block.

seeds.name: User Preferences
seeds.source_query: What durable preferences has the user expressed across sessions about collaboration, communication, tooling, and code style? Skip anything the user already wrote into AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, skill files, or other instruction files, because the agent loads those directly. Skip one-off requests, task progress, and approvals or caveats tied to a single action.

seeds.name: Project Conventions
seeds.source_query: What conventions does this project follow for code style, build, testing, release, and review that are not already stated in its AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, CONTRIBUTING, or other rule files the agent loads directly? Prefer concrete commands, paths, and tool versions. Skip task progress and one-off approvals.

seeds.name: Project Decisions
seeds.source_query: What durable architectural or product decisions have been made for this project, and what rationale or trade-offs were recorded? Exclude decisions already written in the project's rule files, transient plans, unresolved ideas, active task state, and per-action approvals.
